name: Gnome Desktop Icons
description:
Draws file icons on the desktop.

A separate GTK4 helper process does the rendering, the drag-and-drop and the menus. An extension must not import GTK into GNOME Shell, so the work happens there. The extension hands every file operation to Nautilus over D-Bus. The desktop therefore shares the progress windows, the dialogs and the undo stack of Files.

Cut, Copy and Paste read and write the system clipboard. They use the formats Files uses, so you can copy in one and paste in the other. The extension never sends clipboard contents anywhere.
